shots.full: Same bare brick room as the reference image, at night. Camera on the concrete floor looking up: a wooden pallet stacked higher than a man with uncut printed sheets of purple twenty-pound notes, thousands of sheet edges in layers, the top sheet curling slightly at a corner. A pair of black brogues and suit trousers stand beside it for scale. One hard white work lamp in a wire cage rakes across the stack from the right, catching the paper edges; the rest of the room falls to black. Dust in the air. Unretouched 35mm film still, rich saturated colour, fine grain, a little underexposed. 16:9. Thanks.

Night. Looking straight down at a scarred wooden table buried edge to edge in banded bricks of new purple twenty-pound notes, stacked three and four deep, brown paper bands, the notes seen side-on as blocks of edges. A man's hand in a dark suit cuff with a gold signet ring lowers one more brick onto the pile. A whisky glass half-hidden among the bricks. One hard white work lamp from the right throws long shadows between the stacks. Unretouched 35mm film still, rich saturated colour, fine grain, a little underexposed. 16:9. Thanks.
